info.title: Zoho Analytics API
info.description: API for Schedules & Alerts in Zoho Analytics — covering creation, management, and triggering of email schedules.

tags.name: Email Schedules
tags.description: APIs for creating, updating, triggering, and deleting email schedules, and retrieving schedule details.

post.description:
Creates a new recurring email schedule in the workspace and returns its ID.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — Workspace not found. | Verify and the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header. |
| 7104 | METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — A view in viewIds does not exist. | Verify the IDs via Get View List. |
| 7301 | SECURITYNOTPERMITTED — Request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain, the user lacks Create Email Schedule permission, or lacks Export permission on a view in viewIds. | Call from the standard API host with the required permissions. |
| 7319 | OBJIDNOTBELONGSTODB — A view in viewIds belongs to a different workspace. | Include only views from . |
| 7832 | INVALIDEXPORTTYPE — exportType is not one of the supported formats. | Use CSV, XLS, PDF, HTML, or IMG. |
| 8000 | DUPLICATESCHEDULE — A schedule with this scheduleName already exists in the workspace. | Choose a different name. |
| 8001 | MAILCOUNTPERSCHEDEXCEED — Too many recipients for a single schedule. | Reduce the recipient list, or split it across schedules. |
| 8009 | MAILMULTIVIEWMAXCOUNTEXCEEEDED — Too many views in one schedule. | Reduce viewIds, or split across schedules. |
| 8030 | EMAILEXPORTDISABLEDINORG — Email export is disabled for this organization. | Ask the Organization Admin to enable export in Security Controls. |
| 8031 | UNTRUSTEDEMAILIDS — A recipient address is outside the organization's trusted domains. | Use trusted-domain addresses, or ask the Organization Admin to add the domain. |
| 8032 | EMAILINGVIEWDISABLED — Emailing this view is disabled. | Check the view's and workspace's export settings. |
| 8033 | MAILSCHSELECTATLEASTONEEMAILID — No recipient could be resolved from emailIds, groupIds, and cc. | Supply at least one address or a non-empty group. |
| 8034 | ONLYONEDASHBOARDISALLOWEDPERSCH — More than one view scheduled where the first is a dashboard. | Schedule the dashboard on its own. |
| 8035 | EXPORTFORMATSALLOWEDFORDASHBOARD — Dashboard scheduled with a format other than PDF/HTML. | Use PDF or HTML. |
| 8036 | EXPORTFORMATSALLOWEDFORCHART — IMG requested for a view that is not a chart. | Use IMG only for chart views. |
| 8037 | ONLYONEVIEWISALLOWEDFORXLS — XLS requested with more than one view. | Send exactly one view, or choose another format. |
| 8119 | INVALIDVALUEFORATTRIBUTE — A scheduleDetails value is out of range (e.g. hour outside 0–23, minute not a multiple of 5, weekDays outside 1–7, months outside 1–12, skipFrequency beyond the limit for the chosen frequency). | The error message names the attribute and its permitted range; correct the value. |
| 8241 | SYSTEMTAGDATAWARNINGV2VALIDATIONCONFIRMATION — A view carries a restricted DATAWARNING system tag. | Review the warning, then resend with "validateSystemTags": false. |
| 8535 | INVALIDOAUTHTOKEN — Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.create. |

get.description:
Returns every email schedule defined in the workspace, with its name, run period, enabled state, creator, and the views it delivers. This is the discovery call for <schedule-id>, which the other five APIs need.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — Workspace not found. | Verify and that the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header matches it. |
| 7301 | SECURITYNOTPERMITTED — The request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain (where this API is disabled), or the user lacks Create Email Schedule permission on the workspace. | Call from the standard API host as an Account Admin, Organization Admin, Workspace Admin, or a user with Create Email Schedule permission. |
| 8535 | INVALIDOAUTHTOKEN — Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

200.description: Successfully fetched the email schedules of the workspace.

post.description:
Runs a schedule immediately — the "send now" action. This sends real email to every configured recipient, using the schedule's stored configuration.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — Workspace not found. | Verify and the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header. |
| 7106 | METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — The schedule has no surviving views to send. | Recreate the schedule against existing views. |
| 7301 | SECURITYNOTPERMITTED — Request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain, or the user lacks Create Email Schedule permission on the workspace. | Call from the standard API host with the required permission. |
| 7812 | SCHEDULEDELETED — No schedule exists with the given . | Re-resolve the current ID via Get Email Schedules. |
| 8002 | SCHMAILACTIONNOTSUPPORTED — The schedule is not in this workspace, or the caller may not act on it. | Verify the ID belongs to this workspace. |
| 8005 | SCHNOTINWS — The schedule does not belong to the specified workspace. | Ensure and are consistent. |
| 8030 | EMAILEXPORTDISABLEDINORG — Email export is disabled for this organization. | Ask the Organization Admin to enable export in Security Controls. |
| 8032 | EMAILINGVIEWDISABLED — Emailing is disabled for a view in this schedule. | Check the view's and workspace's export settings. |
| 8535 | INVALIDOAUTHTOKEN — Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.create. |

204.description: Email schedule triggered successfully. No content.

put.description:
Updates an existing schedule's name, run period, recipients, or email content. Read Schedule ID Lifecycle first — this call can replace the schedule's ID.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — Workspace not found. | Verify and the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header. |
| 7301 | SECURITYNOTPERMITTED — Request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain, or the user lacks Create Email Schedule permission on the workspace. | Call from the standard API host with the required permission. |
| 7812 | SCHEDULEDELETED — No schedule exists with the given . Commonly a stale ID after an earlier update regenerated it. | Re-resolve the current ID via Get Email Schedules. |
| 8000 | DUPLICATESCHEDULE — Another schedule in the workspace already uses the requested scheduleName. | Choose a different name. |
| 8001 | MAILCOUNTPERSCHEDEXCEED — Too many recipients after the update. | Reduce the recipient list. |
| 8002 | SCHMAILACTIONNOTSUPPORTED — The schedule is not in this workspace, or a custom-role user attempted to edit a schedule they do not own. | Verify the ID belongs to this workspace; otherwise have the schedule's creator or an admin perform the update. |
| 8005 | SCHNOTINWS — The schedule does not belong to the specified workspace. | Ensure and are consistent. |
| 8031 | UNTRUSTEDEMAILIDS — A recipient address is outside the organization's trusted domains. | Use trusted-domain addresses. |
| 8033 | MAILSCHSELECTATLEASTONEEMAILID — The update would leave the schedule with no recipients. | Keep at least one address or non-empty group. |
| 8119 | INVALIDVALUEFORATTRIBUTE — A scheduleDetails value is out of range. | The error message names the attribute and its permitted range. |
| 8241 | SYSTEMTAGDATAWARNINGV2VALIDATIONCONFIRMATION — A delivered view carries a restricted DATAWARNING system tag. | Review the warning, then resend with "validateSystemTags": false. |
| 8535 | INVALIDOAUTHTOKEN — Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.update. |

delete.description:
Permanently deletes an email schedule. The views it delivered are unaffected; only the schedule and its pending runs are removed.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — Workspace not found. | Verify and the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header. |
| 7301 | SECURITYNOTPERMITTED — Request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain, or the user lacks Create Email Schedule permission on the workspace. | Call from the standard API host with the required permission. |
| 7812 | SCHEDULEDELETED — No schedule exists with the given . | Nothing to delete; re-check via Get Email Schedules. |
| 8002 | SCHMAILACTIONNOTSUPPORTED — The schedule is not in this workspace, or a custom-role user attempted to delete a schedule they do not own. | Verify the ID belongs to this workspace; otherwise have the creator or an admin delete it. |
| 8005 | SCHNOTINWS — The schedule does not belong to the specified workspace. | Ensure and are consistent. |
| 8535 | INVALIDOAUTHTOKEN — Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.delete. |

204.description: Email schedule deleted successfully. No content.

put.description:
Activates or deactivates a schedule without deleting it. A deactivated schedule keeps its configuration and ID but stops running automatically.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | METAOBJECTNOTPRESENT — Workspace not found. | Verify and the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header. |
| 7301 | SECURITYNOTPERMITTED — Request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain, or the user lacks Create Email Schedule permission on the workspace. | Call from the standard API host with the required permission. |
| 7812 | SCHEDULEDELETED — No schedule exists with the given . | Re-resolve the current ID via Get Email Schedules. |
| 8002 | SCHMAILACTIONNOTSUPPORTED — The schedule is not in this workspace, or the caller may not act on it. | Verify the ID belongs to this workspace. |
| 8003 | ALLSCHRUNERROR — The schedule could not be activated. | Check that the schedule's views still exist and that the organization is within its schedule quota. |
| 8004 | ALLSCHPAUSEERROR — The schedule could not be deactivated. | Retry; if it persists, verify the schedule still exists. |
| 8005 | SCHNOTINWS — The schedule does not belong to the specified workspace. | Ensure and are consistent. |
| 8119 | INVALIDVALUEFORATTRIBUTE — operation is neither activate nor deactivate. | Send exactly activate or deactivate. |
| 8535 | INVALIDOAUTHTOKEN — Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.update. |

CreateEmailScheduleConfig.title: CreateEmailScheduleConfig
CreateEmailScheduleConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration of the email schedule to be created.

applyShareCriteria.description: Controls whether the share criteria have to be applied.

applyDefaultUf.description: Controls whether the default user filter has to be applied.

validateSystemTags.description:
Controls whether the request has to be validated against the System Tags applied to the views. Applicable only when System Tags are enabled for your organization.

When true, the request is validated against the System Tags applied to the views listed in `viewIds`. If any of those views carries an **Outdated** tag - applied directly, or inherited through lineage from a parent Data Source or Table - the request is rejected and no views are shared. Set it to false to skip this validation and proceed with the request.

isBCC.description: When true (the default), the addresses in emailIds are placed in BCC so recipients cannot see one another. Set false to address them in the To line.

emailAsInline.description: When true, the exported content is rendered inline in the email body instead of being attached as a file. Meaningful for HTML exports.

isNormalDbExp.description: Dashboard export layout switch. When true, the dashboard is exported in the standard document layout rather than the widget-by-widget layout. Applies to dashboard schedules only.

selectedTabs.description: For a tabbed dashboard, restricts delivery to the listed tabs. 0–30 entries. Ignored for other view types.

reportBurstConfig.description: Turns the schedule into a report burst — one personalised email per row of a distribution-list table. See reportBurstConfig Fields.

zaTableId.description: ID of the table holding the distribution list (8040 if not found).

emailColumnId.description: ID of the column in that table containing the recipient email address (8041 if not found).

reports.description: 1–15 report entries, each shaped as below.

objId.description: ID of the view to include in the burst (8046 if not found).

exportFormat.description: Export format for this report entry.

deliveryMode.description: 0 or 1 — how the report is delivered for this entry (8047 if out of range).

criteriaExpression.description: Filter expression applied to this report per recipient. Max 65,535 characters.

sortOrder.description: Position of this report within the email.

filterColumns.description: 0–10 entries mapping distribution-list columns to report columns.

criteriaColumnId.description: Column in the distribution-list table supplying the filter value.

targetColumnId.description: Column in the report that the value filters (8045 if not found).

ScheduleDetails.title: ScheduleDetails
ScheduleDetails.description:
JSONObject with the detailed information about the schedule, such as the time and the frequency at which it runs.

The attributes that apply depend on the `calendarFrequency` value.

- **weekDay**, **weekDays** - applicable for weekly schedules.
- **weekNumber**, **monthDay**, **monthDays** - applicable for monthly schedules.
- **months** - applicable for yearly schedules, along with the relevant day attributes.

calendarFrequency.description: The frequency at which the email schedule has to be triggered.

hour.description: The hour of the day, from 0 to 23, at which the email schedule has to be triggered.

minute.description: The minute within the hour at which the email schedule has to be triggered. Only five-minute intervals are allowed.

weekDay.description: A particular day of the week on which the email schedule has to be triggered.

weekNumber.description: The week of the month in which the email schedule has to be triggered.

monthDay.description: A particular day of the month on which the email schedule has to be triggered. Allowed values are 1 to 31, and 99 to denote the last day of the month.

skipFrequency.description: How many periods to skip between runs — 0 means every period, 1 means every other, and so on. The permitted maximum depends on calendarFrequency: 0–6 for daily, 0–3 for weekly, 0–11 for monthly, 0–4 for yearly.

ScheduleWeekDays.title: ScheduleWeekDays
ScheduleWeekDays.description: JSONArray of the days of the week on which the email schedule has to be triggered.

ScheduleMonthDays.title: ScheduleMonthDays
ScheduleMonthDays.description: JSONArray of the days of the month on which the email schedule has to be triggered. Allowed values are 1 to 31, and 99 to denote the last day of the month.

items.description: A day of the month, or 99 to denote the last day of the month.

UpdateEmailScheduleConfig.title: UpdateEmailScheduleConfig
UpdateEmailScheduleConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration to be applied to the existing email schedule.

validateSystemTags.description:
Controls whether the request has to be validated against the System Tags applied to the views. Applicable only when System Tags are enabled for your organization.

When true, the request is validated against the System Tags applied to the views shared by this schedule. If any of those views carries an **Outdated** tag - applied directly, or inherited through lineage from a parent Data Source or Table - the request is rejected and no views are shared. Set it to false to skip this validation and proceed with the request.

isBCC.description: Whether recipients are addressed via BCC.

selectedTabs.description: For tabbed dashboards, the tabs to deliver. 0–30 entries.

reportBurstConfig.description: Report-burst configuration. See reportBurstConfig Fields. Omitting it removes any existing burst configuration, converting the schedule back to a normal one — this is the one field where omission is not "leave unchanged".
